title: Share resident session rows through the existing sequence owner before deferring summary projection
outcome: Preparatory slice A authorized by Fable1877 and Architect2 ruling46965054a11b4c62bad8f2e19800bead: generalize existing MessageSequence row-COW owner for live SessionRecord storage, adapt collection/rollback boundaries and use immutable predicates before no-op mutable housekeeping. Projection behavior remains unchanged. Slice B owns off-lock summary/cache work, frozen Windows cleanup input and pending-revocation scan. No additional registry/cache/lifecycle.
acceptance: Resident session records reuse the existing shared-sequence owner with per-row copy-on-write, preserving session membership/order, wire and persisted array shape, persistence mutation stamps and rollback semantics; no mutable row or collection alias bypasses detachment.

Deterministic tests show a retained cut survives unstamped direct mutation and remove/rollback; ordinary no-op body-sequence housekeeping clones zero rows, while one pending local row detaches only that row and advances its sequence exactly once, leaving remote and unchanged rows shared.

State summary projection, cache validation and snapshot/delta ordering retain their current behavior in this preparatory slice; no latency improvement or satisfaction of the parent's off-lock snapshot criterion is claimed.

Focused compile/tests cover the storage and housekeeping changes, the independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the integration owner's full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
